cues.en: We're gonna use this Consolab Hybrid Planetary Gearset Trainer to explore the electronic continuously variable transaxle,
cues.zh: 我们将用这台Consolab混合行星齿轮组训练器来探索电子无级变速驱动桥，

cues.en: sometimes called the power split device.
cues.zh: 有时也叫动力分流装置。

cues.en: Really what this boils down to is a very ingenious use of a single planetary gear set. When we study planetary gear sets in automatic transmissions class and we learn the rules such as if you hold the ring and drive the sun, you can see those planets are turned in a forward gear reduction.
cues.zh: 说到底，这其实就是对单一行星齿轮组的巧妙运用。在自动变速箱课程里学习行星齿轮组时，我们会学到一些规则，比如如果固定齿圈、驱动太阳轮，就能看到那些行星轮以前进挡减速方式转动。

cues.en: When we learn all those various planetary gear set rules, what's often ignored is the fact that a planetary gear set can also be used as a differential.
cues.zh: 当我们学习行星齿轮组的各种规则时，常常会忽略一点：行星齿轮组也可以用作差速器。

cues.en: In fact, it can be used as a differential
cues.zh: 实际上，它可以用作差速器，

cues.en: with a single input and two outputs
cues.zh: 一个输入、两个输出，

cues.en: or it can be used as a differential with two inputs
cues.zh: 也可以用作差速器，有两个输入

cues.en: and an output.
cues.zh: 和一个输出。

cues.en: In this case, this differential actually has three separate inputs
cues.zh: 这个例子里，这个差速器实际上有三个独立的输入，

cues.en: and a single output.
cues.zh: 和一个输出。

cues.en: The sun gear is color coded green.
cues.zh: 太阳轮标为绿色。

cues.en: Green is tied to what this trainer calls m g one. Ford would call that the generator motor,
cues.zh: 绿色对应这个教具上所谓的 MG1。Ford 则会称其为发电机电机，

cues.en: but whenever the generator motor
cues.zh: 但只要发电机电机

cues.en: rotates either forward or reverse,
cues.zh: 正转或反转，

cues.en: that rotates the sun gear.
cues.zh: 就会带动太阳轮旋转。

cues.en: Color coded in red are the planetary
cues.zh: 用红色标出的则是行星架

cues.en: carrier and the planetary
cues.zh: 以及行星

cues.en: pinions.
cues.zh: 齿轮。

cues.en: Now from the front, the engine can only rotate clockwise.
cues.zh: 现在从正面看，发动机只能顺时针旋转。

cues.en: So from our view, those planetary
cues.zh: 所以在我们看来，那些行星

cues.en: pinions need to only rotate in the counter clockwise direction.
cues.zh: 齿轮就只能逆时针方向旋转。

cues.en: Color coded in blue is the ring gear, and the ring gear is what this trainer calls MG two,
cues.zh: 蓝色标注的是齿圈，培训师把齿圈称为MG two，

cues.en: Ford would call that the traction motor.
cues.zh: Ford那边叫它牵引电机。

cues.en: Also connected to the ring gear, connected to the traction motor is the drive wheels. So obviously the drive wheels can go forward or reverse
cues.zh: 驱动轮也连在齿圈上，连着牵引电机。所以驱动轮显然可以正转或反转，

cues.en: and motor generator two can go forward or reverse.
cues.zh: 电机发电机二也可以正转或反转。

cues.en: First thing typically we wanna do when we get in the car is to start it and if the wheels are stationary and motor generator one is rotated, that rotates that sun gear, that rotates those planetary pinions,
cues.zh: 通常上车后第一件事就是启动，如果车轮静止，而电机发电机一转动，就会带动太阳轮转动，进而带动行星小齿轮转动，

cues.en: and that's how the engine is started. In most hybrid vehicles, we don't use a conventional 12 volt starter.
cues.zh: 发动机就是这样启动的。大多数混合动力车不用传统的12伏起动机。

cues.en: We start it up through the action
cues.zh: 我们是通过这套机构来启动它的，

cues.en: of the ECVT
cues.zh: 也就是通过 ECVT

cues.en: and the motor generator.
cues.zh: 以及发电机。

cues.en: Once the engine is running, now the engine can spin that planetary gear set and the engine is spinning the motor generator,
cues.zh: 一旦发动机运转起来，它就能带动行星齿轮组旋转，进而带动发电机运转，

cues.en: so now that motor generator is recharging the battery to replenish that energy that we used in order to to start the engine.
cues.zh: 这样发电机就会给电池充电，补充我们之前启动发动机所消耗的电量。

cues.en: When we're ready to drive the vehicle, whether it be in forward or reverse,
cues.zh: 当我们准备驾驶车辆时，无论是前进还是倒车，

cues.en: we have to turn MG two. MG two is tied directly to the ring gear, which is tied directly to the drive wheels.
cues.zh: 我们都必须转动 MG2。MG2 直接与齿圈相连，而齿圈又直接连着驱动轮。

cues.en: Now when motor generator two turns,
cues.zh: 现在，当 2 号电动发电机转动时，

cues.en: if motor generator one is turned in the opposite direction, see I can actually keep that engine still. The computer would do a better job of it than I can, but I can drive the vehicle without the engine rotating
cues.zh: 如果 1 号电动发电机反向转动，看，我其实能让发动机保持静止。车载电脑会比我控制得更好，但不用发动机转动，我也能驱动车辆，

cues.en: by rotating each of the motor generators
cues.zh: 只需让两个电动发电机

cues.en: in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 反向旋转即可。

cues.en: But maybe I want the engine to drive and the engine's gonna drive the wheels.
cues.zh: 但也许我想让发动机驱动，发动机将用来驱动车轮。

cues.en: I can have the whole assembly
cues.zh: 我可以让整个总成

cues.en: rotate in unison.
cues.zh: 同步旋转。

cues.en: I can have the
cues.zh: 我可以让

cues.en: MG one, MG two, and the internal combustion engine all rotate at the same RPM.
cues.zh: MG one、MG two 和內燃机都以相同的 RPM 旋转。

cues.en: When it's referred to an electronic
cues.zh: 当它被称为电子

cues.en: continuously variable transaxle,
cues.zh: 无级变速驱动桥时，

cues.en: that's because the ratio between the engine and the drive wheel is continuously variable
cues.zh: 这是因为发动机与驱动轮之间的传动比是连续可变的

cues.en: based on the action of motor generator one and the sun gear.
cues.zh: 基于电机发电机 one 和太阳轮的作用。

cues.en: At a given vehicle speed, I can have the engine, motor generator one, motor generator two all operate at the same speed,
cues.zh: 在给定车速下，我可以让发动机、电机发电机 one、电机发电机 two 都以相同转速运行，

cues.en: but I can also change the speed of that engine by changing the operation
cues.zh: 但我也可以通过改变

cues.en: of motor generator one. So I'm attempting to keep a steady
cues.zh: 电机发电机 one 的运行来改变发动机的转速。所以我在试图保持稳定的

cues.en: vehicle speed. It's a little tricky, but attempting to keep a steady vehicle speed
cues.zh: 车速。这有点棘手，但试图保持稳定的车速

cues.en: while I manipulate
cues.zh: 同时我操控

cues.en: the action of motor generator one,
cues.zh: 电机发电机 one 的动作，

cues.en: and you can see as I do that, the ratio between the engine
cues.zh: 你可以看到我这样做时，发动机之间的传动比

cues.en: represented by the red planetary
cues.zh: 由红色行星齿轮表示

cues.en: gears
cues.zh: 齿轮

cues.en: and the vehicle speed represented by the blue
cues.zh: 由蓝色齿圈表示的车速

cues.en: ring gear is in fact continuously variable.
cues.zh: 实际上是连续可变的。

cues.en: The transaxle can operate under several different modes depending if we're trying to start the engine, trying to recharge the battery, drive under a heavy acceleration, light acceleration,
cues.zh: 根据不同的需求，变速驱动桥可以在多种模式下运行，比如启动发动机、给电池充电、急加速、轻加速，

cues.en: regenerative braking,
cues.zh: 再生制动，

cues.en: all of those have different modes of operation for motor generator one, motor generator two,
cues.zh: 这些情况下，电动发电机一号、电动发电机二号

cues.en: and the internal combustion engine.
cues.zh: 以及内燃机都会采用不同的运行模式。
